summary: Tested Admin page, MSL netting, missing-BOM manual override, and AI categorization quality (same session as iteration_20/21/22, light regression done). Backend: 12/12 new pytest tests passed (part-overrides, admin CRUD, recategorize skip-manual, AI category quality). Frontend: Admin page fully functional (search/filter/select-all/recategorize/MSL persistence all verified in live browser). Ran a full live Purchasing Plan generation (~120s) and verified MSL column + netting math correct for SPC5WM (msl=500). CRITICAL FINDING: the 'Fix Mapping' UI (missing-bom-override-input/save) described in the review request and files_of_reference does NOT exist anywhere in PurchasingPlanPage.js - grep for 'override' in that file returns zero matches. The Missing BOMs table only has Status/OMS Part No/Mapped SAP ID/Reason columns, no input or save button per row. Backend endpoint POST /api/purchasing-plan/part-overrides itself works correctly, but there is no way for an end user to use it from the UI.

minor.issue: Standard cost lookup failed during my live test run (SAP OData valuation endpoint connect-timeout) causing all unit_cost/value_by_month/net_value_by_month to be null/0.00 for that run - handled gracefully (best-effort, doesn't crash the plan) but is a live SAP tenant connectivity flake, not a code bug from this session's changes. Flagging since it currently blocks visually verifying Gross/Net Value stat cards with real numbers.

integration_issues.issue: Feature described in review request/files_of_reference (data-testid='missing-bom-override-input-{i}', 'missing-bom-override-save-{i}', functions saveOverride/overrideInputs/savingOverride) is completely absent from /app/frontend/src/pages/PurchasingPlanPage.js - confirmed via full file view and grep (zero matches for 'override'). The backend endpoint POST /api/purchasing-plan/part-overrides works correctly and was verified via pytest, but there is no UI entry point to call it. This is a HIGH priority gap since it's one of the two headline features of this session.

action_items: HIGH: Implement the 'Fix Mapping' column (input + 'Save & Retry' button per row) in the Missing BOMs table on PurchasingPlanPage.js, wiring to POST /api/purchasing-plan/part-overrides as described in the review request - it is currently entirely missing from the frontend despite the backend being ready and tested.

Optional/low: investigate why CUCOIL-1.86's category_source flipped from 'manual' (set during my PATCH test) back to 'ai' sometime after my test completed - backend logs show a recategorize call from a different IP shortly after, likely a concurrent dev/testing session on the same live DB rather than a logic bug (the manual-skip protection itself was verified correct within my own test sequence). Just noting for awareness, not asserting it's a real bug.
